title: BC decal corrections — second overlay review

figures.title: 1983 JUN, 1999 MAY and 2004 year construction
figures.caption: Original BCpl8s crops and equal-painted-height overlays. Magenta is source-only ink, blue model-only ink, and dark their overlap. Widths are preserved; ratios are not accuracy scores.

figures.title: Later modern year shapes and advances
figures.caption: Actual registered profiles compared at equal painted height. The repeated photographs support a separate later printing group; fine 3/9 details remain limited.

figures.title: Modern JAN: measured pair gaps, retained contours
figures.caption: Native font substitution was rejected on the A counter and J/N proportions. Exact JAN variants receive observed spacing and uniform registration; residual letter shapes remain visible.

figures.title: 2021 JUL: native Anton and observed pair spacing
figures.caption: Three existing JUL photographs corroborate the direction of the change. Production scope is exact 2021 JUL. The native L foot remains short and the J hook slightly high.

figures.title: Wide 1981–1982 province capitals
figures.caption: Larger 1981 OCT photograph by Jerry Woody, CC BY-SA 2.0. The independently authored fixed-word alphabet is limited to twelve observed capitals; fine print spread remains approximate.

figures.title: Tall 2010–2013 province capitals
figures.caption: Larger 2012 AUG photograph by PartColumbia, CC BY-SA 4.0. Original photo tilt remains; the remaining whole-word width difference is not hidden by horizontal scaling.

figures.title: 1990 control placement: complete composition
figures.caption: The exact JAN control moves down and slightly left. Source, before/after and painted bounds are retained together; this does not establish the position of every other month.

figures.title: Photographic colour variation and the retained palette
figures.caption: Explicit substrate patches from the enlarged 2015 and November 2017 BCpl8s photographs. Pixel colours vary within each source; these are decoded photographic values, not calibrated physical colour specifications.
